findings: The company reports employing a specialized bundle of third-party software packages and proprietary algorithms across its photogrammetric and LiDAR processing workflows, utilizing tools such as TerraScan, TerraModeler, TerraPhoto, Global Mapper, MicroStation, PowerDraft, and MicroStation CONNECT Edition for point cloud classification, DTM/DSM generation, and feature extraction.
